explanation: The hijacking drew the international press to Portugal and its empire, and several accounts hold that the Luanda attacks of early February were timed to strike while that attention was still on Lisbon, giving them a hearing they would not otherwise have had.

dispute.text: Against that, the risings in Luanda had their own causes and their own calendar: the cotton and coffee grievances, and the prisoners the attackers set out to free. On that reading the dates coincide and nothing more. Whether either set of organisers knew of the other's plans is not established.
